endorsements.quote: Providers of AIRR-seq assays for clinical use must comply with GDPR, obtain relevant certifications such as ISO 27,001, and adhere to country-specific regulations.
In fact, models distributed to multiple laboratories are not considered LDTs and must be validated for their intended use by the clinical laboratory.

unlisted_practices: Establish standardized quality controls, reference materials, and external quality assessment programs for AIRR-seq assays.
Use interpretable machine learning models so expert clinicians can incorporate immune repertoire insights alongside other clinical parameters.
Apply privacy-preserving analytics such as homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, differential privacy, federated learning, and secure processing environments to health data.
Expand AIRR-seq data repositories with well-characterized patient samples linked to clinical metadata and treatment outcomes.
Standardize protocols for sample collection, processing, and data sharing.
Address underrepresentation of non-European populations in germline gene and HLA databases to avoid systematic misassignment.

screen.reason: This is a perspective piece outlining challenges, bioinformatics/machine learning approaches, and future directions/guidelines for the clinical adoption of AIRR-seq diagnostics.
